# Retained-deformation staged and partial controls

These literal JSON and GLB sources exercise real late physical readback failure,
no-replace collision, FILE report-worker cancellation and report extent refusal.
`stage-rich` preserves the existing catalog duplicate/stride source bytes and its
three explicit row-local declarations. The native test adds one explicitly
inventoried opaque physical member and changes it only after the actual
conditional report barrier.

`node-partial` admits one node rotation before refusing node1.
`payload-partial` admits the first FLOAT32 rotation value before refusing
accessor3,row1. `weight-partial` changes only accessor4,row1,lane0 of the
existing dense floating source to -1. Its expected evaluated rows0/2 require
actual independent row partitions, not the fixed Python serial preset.
The checked literal expectations describe source-local values; native execution
and joined-worker observations remain required.

Run the qualified `gltf_deformation_staged_controls` CTest with a matching
installed Interchange/Geometry SDK. The binary also accepts an optional absent
output directory after this fixture directory to retain reports and physical
artifacts. An opt-in isolated binding test consumes the same fixture files;
its test-only work override is not a public API or normal-module qualification.
